    SELECT s.XCL_019 AS name, s.XCL_022 AS eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
Tot AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.XCL_022 = (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM TopHero) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
)
SELECT t.name,
       (CAST(tot.same AS REAL) * 100 / tot.total) AS percentage
FROM TopHero t
CROSS JOIN Tot tot;

)
SELECT t.name,
       (CAST(tot.same AS REAL) * 100 / tot.total) AS percentage
FROM TopHero t

WITH TopHero AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_019 AS name, c.XCL_006 AS eye_color
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female' AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics' AND a.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
Tot AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_006 = (SELECT eye_color FROM TopHero) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female' AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
)
SELECT t.name, (CAST(tot.same AS FLOAT) / tot.total) * 100 AS percentage
FROM TopHero t CROSS JOIN Tot tot;
